summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its annual reference form (Formulário de Referência) for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes standard disclosures on business history, risk factors, governance, compensation, and capital structure, with historical context dating back to a 2013 share restructuring. There is no transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return event being announced. This is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
